name: Origin Node Z Parameter (COMPAS CEM)
description: Set the Z coordinate of an origin node as an optimization parameter.

inputParameters.name: node_key
inputParameters.description: The key of a COMPAS CEM origin node.

inputParameters.name: bound_low
inputParameters.description: The smallest Z coordinate the origin node may take. The start value must lie between the bounds. Defaults to '-inf'.

inputParameters.name: bound_up
inputParameters.description: The largest Z coordinate the origin node may take. The start value must lie between the bounds. Defaults to '+inf'.

outputParameters.name: parameter
outputParameters.description: A COMPAS CEM origin node Z parameter.
